metadata.selection: Post-hoc good-prediction illustration: among alternative test rows whose reference first crosses 80% SOH after cycle 1000, choose the lowest mean per-draw forecast RMSE in the existing ten-draw cache. Display the lowest-RMSE fresh draw whose own 80% crossing is also after cycle 1000. This is not an unbiased or aggregate performance estimate.
metadata.identityNote: The numeric archive has no serialized cell IDs. The display cell number is the one-based test-array row, not a source battery identifier.

selectionMetrics.metricDefinition: SOH RMSE in percentage points, excluding the ten known prefix coordinates and including the first reference 80% crossing. No clipping or smoothing; ranking uses the mean of all ten individual draw RMSEs, not the best cached draw.

eligibility.rule: Both the reference and displayed prediction must first reach 80% SOH after cycle 1000; the previous test row 0 is excluded.

cachedTopFive.eolRule: First exported SOH value at or below 80%; ten-cycle grid, without interpolation.

selectionMetrics.freshInferenceNote: Ten fresh CPU draws use a seed reset after model loading. Their noise draws need not match the cached multi-cell batch, so fresh metrics are reported separately.

metadata.referenceType: Preprocessed, causally smoothed reference SOH; not raw cycle measurements.

recommendedInferenceView.note: Display window only. Exported states and predictions retain all 256 coordinates through cycle 2551; out-of-window noise is not clipped in the data.

capacity.orientation: Rows low-to-high voltage; columns early battery cycles. PNG top is highest voltage.
capacity.paperColormapSource: Original Figure 1 capacity contours in manuscript/figs/drawing_artwork.svg use the Matplotlib cool palette.
capacity.definition: Discharge capacity at each cycle minus the cycle-10 capacity curve, in Ah.
capacity.preprocessing: Exact prepared 100×100 matrix. The original pipeline sets cycle 11 to zero, retains zero baseline cycle 10, and replaces non-finite values by zero. No display smoothing or downsampling.

trajectories.referenceDisplayRule: Reference shown through its first 80% SOH crossing, excluding the later 70% padding floor. Exact raw measured length is unavailable.
trajectories.sampleDisplayRule: Final predicted trajectories may be shown through their individual first 80% crossings. No values are clipped or smoothed in this export.

generation.stateMeaning: Actual ODE solution outputs at 101 requested times; not adaptive solver steps or linear morphs.
